results.title: Africa launches West Africa research programme to speed up outbreak response
results.content: A new regional initiative is seeking to strengthen West Africa’s preparedness for public health emergencies by connecting research institutions and enabling faster, more coordinated responses to disease outbreaks. The Africa Research Preparedness Programme for West Africa is designed to address gaps in research coordination that experts say could delay critical interventions during outbreaks of diseases such as Ebola, Mpox, Lassa fever and COVID-19. Despite the presence of skilled scientists and established research institutions across the continent, preparedness remains uneven, with some clinical trial sites facing challenges transitioning from routine research to emergency response. Head of Africa Strategy and Engagement at the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI), Shingai Machingaidze, said the programme would adopt a hub-and-spoke model to connect existing research

results.title: UG commissions Alex A. Dadey Centre in honour of Dr Alexander Apau Dadey Snr, Father of KGL Boss
results.content: The University of Ghana (UG) has commissioned the Alex A. Dadey Centre at its Legon campus in honour of Dr Alexander Apau Dadey Snr., a veteran educationist and administrator whose career spanned teaching, institutional leadership and public service. The facility was commissioned on Friday, October 23, 2026, in a partnership between the University and the University of Ghana Alumni Association (UGAA). To ensure its long-term sustainability, the KGL Foundation has committed to funding the centre for the next 20 years. Speaking at the ceremony, the Vice-Chancellor of the University of Ghana, Professor Nana Aba Appiah Amfo, said Dr Dadey Snr. was a former student of the University who later served on its governing council from 1978 to 1985.
